test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The famous coal mining region ‘Korba’ is located in which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Korba** is a famous coal mining region located in the state of **Chhattisgarh**.
 
• Chhattisgarh is known for its rich mineral resources, and Korba is one of the prominent areas for coal production.
 
• The region plays a significant role in the energy sector of India, contributing to the supply of coal for thermal power plants.
 
• Korba is also known for its industrial setup and has several power plants and industries based on coal mining.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Chhattisgarh was formed on **1st November 2000**, by partitioning 16 Chhattisgarhi-speaking southeastern districts of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The state is known for its **dense forests, waterfalls, and rich cultural heritage**.
 
• Other notable coal mining regions in Chhattisgarh include **Raigarh, Bilaspur, and Surguja**.
 
• Chhattisgarh is often referred to as the **'Rice Bowl of India'** due to its rich paddy fields.
